title: Definite Articles: il, la, lo, l', i, gli, le

blocks.markdown: Italian nouns have gender and number, and the definite article agrees with both: **il** (masc. sing.), **la** (fem. sing.), **lo** (masc. sing. before s+consonant/z), **l'** (before a vowel), **i** (masc. plural), **gli** (masc. plural before vowel/s+consonant/z), **le** (fem. plural).

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct article for "pane" (bread — masculine).
Choose the correct article for "acqua" (water — feminine, starts with a vowel).
